company.shortDescription: Telecosys is a software products and solutions provider empowering tech-based service providers, including telecom, internet, and more.
company.description:
Telecosys is a software products and solutions provider empowering tech-based service providers, including telecom, internet, cable TV, and cloud-based service providers by offering Next Generation and Greenfield solutions. This joint stock company has been founded by a group of telecom and IT experts of more than 10-year experience. It has a team that delivers innovation based around experience.


Telecosys was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Egypt. The company is funded by Sawari Ventures, a venture capital firm in the Middle East and North Africa.
